name: Hotel Alpenfriede
beschreibung: The Hotel Alpenfriede is nestled in a sunny, peaceful panoramic position in Jerzens within the Pitztal, surrounded by larch forests and framing unobstructed vistas of the Pitztal mountain peaks. Comfortably furnished in an authentic Tyrolean country style, the guest rooms feature contemporary en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and private balconies overlooking the valley floor. To recharge following active outdoor pursuits, the on-site wellness haven with Finnish sauna and relaxation lounge invites guests to rest. Each morning features a wholesome breakfast buffet laden with regional delicacies, followed by hearty Tyrolean dishes in the evening. The lower lift station of the popular Hochzeiger ski and hiking realm is just minutes away via the complimentary ski bus. In summer, the fragrant Swiss Stone Pine Park (ZirbenPark) delights visitors.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy alpine hotel in Jerzens in the Pitztal offering sunny balcony rooms, sauna area, and close proximity to the Hochzeiger ski resort.
